svg.title: Incident report: force-push on a Friday
svg.desc: A pink T. rex fires laser beams from its eyes at the pixel cat after a force-push. The cat flashes into an X-ray skeleton, turns to charcoal, crumbles into ash leaving its skeleton, then git revert brings it back with one of its nine lives used up.
